author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** Add ObservationKind::ModeratorBehaviorAnomaly { moderator_id, action_count, window_secs } to polaris-types. New polaris-backend/src/pattern/moderator_anomaly.rs: pure detect_moderator_anomaly(actions: &[Action], threshold, window) -> Option<ModeratorAnomaly>. Hook into action insert path: after every action, query count of actions for that moderator in last N seconds; if > threshold, insert an Observation. Config: POLARIS_MODERATOR_ANOMALY_THRESHOLD (default 50), POLARIS_MODERATOR_ANOMALY_WINDOW_SECS (default 3600). Un-ignore threat_t1 detector test.
